maddeler.e:
اقتضين (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَيْنَ (iqtaḍayna) /iq.ta.dˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اُقْتُضِينَ (uqtuḍīna) /uq.tu.dˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اِقْتَضِينَ (iqtaḍīna) /iq.ta.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
